title: Humor Genome Open Controls
subtitle: 120K matched controls with easy and entity-masked hard retrieval tracks
description: A deterministic, CC0 corpus of 120,000 matched four-arm text controls for testing expected continuations, unresolved surprise, compact lexical repair, and over-explanation. Includes leakage-safe template-family splits, original and entity/pivot-masked hard retrieval qrels, explicit hard negatives, strict schemas, provenance, adversarial audits, and SHA-256 manifests. These are synthetic experimental controls, not human ratings or funniness labels.
userSpecifiedSources: Deterministically generated from project-controlled lexical frames. No imported jokes, LLM calls, network calls, human-authored rows, or human ratings are included.

resources.description: Analysis-ready copy of all 120,000 matched synthetic-control rows.

Hard-track content digest, leakage audit, relation origin, counts, and truth boundary.

Executive summary, evidence boundaries, design, limitations, and responsible-use guidance.
